description: Conservative engineering pose: arms lowered alongside the torso and rotated clear of the fixed bed, both elbows mildly flexed, head mildly rotated; trunk and legs neutral.
selection_evidence: Fixed-transform sweeps showed X80/E25 alone penetrated the bed by about 0.128 m. Mirrored shoulder Y +18/-18 degrees kept both arms alongside the torso and moved the global body minimum to 0.00719 m above the frozen bed plane without changing camera, bed, or rigid prone transform.
limitations: Engineering pose only; not clinician-approved positioning.
No pillow, face cradle, mattress deformation, breathing, or soft-tissue contact simulation.
